thread:
Jess_Cust: Hey team — our org showed 0 credits at 00:30 IST this morning but billing page says reset is at 00:00 local. API still 429ing. Anyone seen this?
Sam_Support: Sorry about that, can you share org id and a request id from a 429 response? Also what timezone is your account set to?
Jess_Cust: Org: org_axyz, request_id: req_01H6abcdef. Attached curl response:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Reset-At: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z
Content-Type: application/json
{
 "error":"quota_exhausted",
 "message":"monthly bucket depleted"
}
```
Sam_Support: Thanks. Noting X-Reset-At is 00:00Z. Your tenant timezone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+5:30) right? That would show in UI as 05:30 local.
Elena_Eng: Pinged infra — quick hypothesis: display shows tenant-local midnight but refill runs against account/billing UTC midnight anchored to account creation. For +5:30 that becomes 05:30 local, but customer reports 00:30 local he saw 0 — odd.
Raj_Billing: Checking billing logs for org_axyz... seeing refill job ran at 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z as expected. But I also see a manual plan change around 2026-02-28T18:00:00Z that proration-adjusted buckets. Could that cause visible 0 until finalization?
Jess_Cust: We didn't change plan. We did have a long-running streaming session that started 2026-02-28T23:45 IST and stayed open past midnight.
Elena_Eng: Ah — here's the root cause we found in staging: long-lived websocket sessions were still being billed against the old bucket and UI cache invalidation was using tenant-local midnight rounding. For half-hour timezones the UI pre-computes "next refill" naive local midnight but the API returns UTC-reset timestamps; when a streaming session keeps token counters alive across the boundary we temporarily surface 0s for the UI while backend finalizes counters. Edge-case for +5:30 (and other non-hour offsets).
Sam_Support: Steps to repro we've used:
1) Create tenant in Asia/Kolkata
2) Start a streaming session that holds a rolling token window across UTC midnight
3) Observe API 429s for new requests until billing job finalizes counters (~minutes)
Repro curl snippet:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"x", "prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Ops-bot: Incident created: INC-12345 — billing/refill race for half-hour timezones
Raj_Billing: Short-term: manual top-up for org_axyz applied (10k tokens) and customer refunded. Long-term: engineering will unify UI next-reset calc to use API-provided X-Reset-At and add cache-flush for streaming sessions.
Elena_Eng: Working patch to (a) use authoritative reset header for UI, (b) force counter finalization for sessions at UTC midnight, and (c) add metric to detect delta>2m between UI and backend. Deployed to staging now.
Sam_Support: Jess — we applied a temporary credit and issued a refund. Can you confirm traffic is passing now?
Jess_Cust: Confirmed, calls succeed now, thanks for the fast help :relieved:
Elena_Eng: Filed follow-up GH issue #7890 and KB draft: "Why UI may show 0 before monthly refill completes (non-hour timezones & streaming sessions)". We'll update docs and alerting.
Sam_Support: Closing thread when KB live. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
